ideas.name: NVIDIA Corporation
ideas.thesis: NVDA appeared in all 13 overnight screens with unanimous high conviction — the strongest signal of the morning. With Q2 FY2027 earnings confirmed for August 26 after close, the stock trades at ~$224 against a 61-analyst consensus price target of ~$303 (~35% gap) while valued at just 21x forward earnings despite ~95% YoY revenue growth. Data center revenue consensus exceeds $80B vs Q1's $75.2B, with $600B+ in hyperscaler capex underpinning demand visibility. A defined-risk call spread (Sept/Oct expiry) is the preferred structure to capture the catalyst upside while capping downside from a 'sell-the-news' reaction.
ideas.catalyst: Q2 FY2027 earnings report: August 26, 2026, after market close
ideas.edge: 61-analyst consensus target ~$303 vs current ~$224 = ~35% upside gap; trades at 21x forward earnings in line with S&P 500 despite ~95% YoY revenue growth; EPS estimates revised up 6.8% over past 3 months; data center revenue consensus >$80B vs Q1's $75.2B
ideas.bull_case: A beat-and-raise cycle — historically underpriced by options implied move — combined with hyperscaler capex confirmation could catalyze a rapid re-rating toward analyst targets; options structures allow asymmetric participation.
ideas.bear_case: Even a strong beat risks a 'sell-the-news' selloff given the stock's 18-day run into the print; any softness in forward guidance or data center revenue miss could pressure shares sharply lower from elevated expectations.

ideas.name: SK Hynix Inc. Sponsored ADR
ideas.thesis: SKHY appeared in all 13 overnight screens, matching NVDA for perfect consensus. Despite reporting record 76% operating margins and 257% YoY revenue growth, the stock has been crushed ~29% from its 52-week high of $194.80 to ~$138 on macro and geopolitical fear — creating the widest valuation dislocation on the watchlist. The 13 Buy / 0 Sell analyst consensus targets $244.92 (+77.6% upside), with Cantor Fitzgerald initiating at Overweight targeting ~$280. ideas.edge: Consensus analyst price target $244.92 vs current ~$137.91 = +77.6% upside gap; 13 Buy / 0 Sell analyst ratings; Cantor Fitzgerald projects ~100% upside; record 76% operating margin and 257% YoY revenue growth already reported; 52-week support near $133 provides defined stop level
ideas.bull_case: Macro fear has completely decoupled price from record fundamentals; HBM4 ramp, shareholder return catalyst, and the AI memory supercycle create multiple simultaneous re-rating triggers that could rapidly close the analyst target gap.
ideas.bear_case: Geopolitical risk (Korea-China trade tensions, export control escalation) and broader semiconductor cycle concerns could keep the ADR discounted indefinitely; a break below $133 52-week support would invalidate the technical setup.
